annotations.title: Which of these names do people discuss most online?

description: Use when the user is comparing community attention across competitors or products: "do developers talk about us or them more?", "which tool gets more discussion?". Returns each name's Hacker News mentions and Bluesky posts, with its share on each. Not Reddit or X. Counts only. Refuses before you are charged if none has a mention. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: over days; compare: names (2-4); segment: platform (Hacker News, Bluesky). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For one name in depth (weekly spikes, top threads), use run_social_pulse.
